marketLayer.title: US Big Tech Earnings & AI Infrastructure Capex
marketLayer.fact: Major US technology companies reported strong quarterly cloud revenue growth while reaffirming elevated capital expenditures for AI data center expansion through the rest of the year.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained high capex commitments support valuations across upstream semiconductor manufacturers and server component providers, though software margin compression may trigger near-term volatility.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Pace of enterprise AI monetization and potential delays in next-generation GPU chip deliveries.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Tech Index Rebound & Southbound Inflows
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index closed higher following significant net Southbound capital inflows via Stock Connect, primarily targeting large-cap internet and e-commerce platforms.
marketLayer.inference: Mainland institutional capital continues to build defensive positions in discounted Chinese tech equities, providing strong baseline price support despite macroeconomic headwinds.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Consumer spending momentum during Q3 and upcoming quarterly earnings guidance from platform majors.

marketLayer.title: Federal Reserve Monetary Policy & Liquidity Outlook
marketLayer.fact: U.S. macroeconomic indicators showed cooling labor metrics and moderate inflation, driving market expectations for a rate cut at the upcoming FOMC meeting and pulling down 10-year Treasury yields.
marketLayer.inference: Declining risk-free yields ease valuation pressure on long-duration assets, creating a favorable liquidity backstop for emerging market tech equities and US growth sectors.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential hawkish pushback from Fed officials at upcoming central bank symposiums.

marketLayer.title: Electric Vehicle Sector Price Dynamics & Export Expansion
marketLayer.fact: Leading Chinese EV automakers reported accelerated monthly export volumes into Southeast Asia and Europe, offsetting domestic price competition.
marketLayer.inference: Overseas market expansion offers critical margin relief for vertically integrated auto manufacturers, driving differentiation between tier-1 producers and smaller domestic players.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Finalization of international trade tariffs and local regulatory compliance costs in target export destinations.
